author: GamingBolt
description:
Decades pass, and the debate over whether an expansion should aim to innovate and, well, expand on the base experience or offer more of the same continues with Ghost of Yotei's Echoes of Sekigahara. Anyone who played Iki Island, Ghost of Tsushima's paid expansion, probably knows not to expect anything revolutionary. 

But even if that's the case, Sucker Punch Productions should deliver an experience that best represents the high points of the base game. A compelling narrative, characters that are flawed yet endearing, gorgeous landscapes where you want the wind to guide your path while engaging in momentary distractions, you get the idea.
title: Ghost of Yotei: Echoes of Sekigahara + Most Wanted Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Over a week after launch, and at the point where it's now possible to engage in infinite New Game Plus runs, it feels like a good time to talk about the ending of Control Resonant. It's funny because, seven years after the original, your mind is probably racing with all the potential answers.

Perhaps we'll learn more about the Hiss. Or where Dr Caspar Darling has disappeared. And what about The Board, especially since it's returned after Jesse cut it off at the end of Control's Foundation DLC? What is its agenda in all of this?
title: Control Resonant Ending Explained And How It Sets Up Control 3

author: GamingBolt
description:
Soulslike are hardly in short supply, so standing out from the crowd takes more than punishing combat and checkpoint systems. Valor Mortis is one-such Soulslike which looks to do things differently, combining brutal action with first-person perspectives, plus supernatural abilities, and surprisingly nimble parkour mechanics. 

Throw in a historical setting corrupted into something considerably darker than war, and there’s plenty here which should elevate Valor Mortis above the competition. Before you decide to give it a go, here’s fifteen things you need to know.
title: Valor Mortis - 15 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy
